more self-testing and verification, with the model checking its own work

its hallucination rate also increased from 25% to 54%

unknown: SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): no Grok entry on Scale's leaderboard (11 rows: Claude, GPT, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Inkling)
METR 50% time horizon: not measured; METR's page lists only Grok-4 (2025) and names Grok 4.3 as unmeasured
Terminal-Bench 4.0 harness for this model's row: the card does not name it
knowledge cutoff: the model card gives a January 2026 pretraining cutoff (data generated as late as June 2026 in supplemental training); no schema key holds it

max_output: no maximum is published; the model page gives none, the release note says no text output limit, and the API reference sets a default cap of 128,000 visible tokens when max_output_tokens is unset

prompting_guides: xAI publishes no prompting guide for a current text model; the pages listed are the maker's reasoning, prompt-caching and Grok Build instruction-file pages, which cover this model; the Grok 4.7 overview is not listed because it describes 4.7 only
